paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: WLD-0022 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Museum acquires antique clock collection SOURCE_NAME: Asgard Herald SOURCE_TYPE: news RELIABILITY: 3 PUB_DATE: 2024-10-02 PUB_TIME: 12:00 COUNTRY: Dorin SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Museum acquires antique clock collection

[P1] A private collector has donated more than sixty antique clocks to a museum in Dorin. The oldest item is a wooden wall clock with a hand-painted face, and the newest dates from the early part of the last century.
[P2] Staff will spend the winter cleaning and cataloguing the collection. Several clocks still work, but most will be displayed with their mechanisms stopped to reduce wear.

[P3] The museum plans to open a small exhibition in the spring. A clockmaker has offered to give a public talk about repair techniques, and the museum is looking for volunteers to help record the collection.
